_doc: The Likeness Sheet for the homage bosses (ULTIMATE PROMPT v3 §1; docs/HOMAGE_BOSSES.md §2). Edit this file to change a look or a name; the defaults are used until a value is filled in. PLACEHOLDER RULE: any string that starts with '[' and ends with ']' (e.g. "[COUSIN_1_NAME]") is an unfilled placeholder; code must never show it to a player and uses the matching *_default instead (an empty default means 'leave it out': the POW card shows the surname line blank, the art falls back to the 'defaults' look). The models are stylized and zombified, never photoreal. A photo or face scan may only be used if it sits in res://assets/user_supplied/likeness/ with a note that the person agreed (consent.note_file); none has been supplied. The Cousins are young women written as creepy-doll horror and are never sexualized (HOMAGE_BOSSES.md §1.2). Not loaded yet: HB1 adds the loader (Data.TABLES is a flat list; this lives in a subfolder on purpose).

consent._doc: photo_scans_allowed stays false until a consent note for that person exists in dir; then set the person's 'scan' field to the file name.

cousin_1.quirk: Throws the mallet like a boomerang and catches it

paul._quirk_doc: PAUL_SIGNATURE: a catchphrase, a team, an item, a tattoo... Each kind has a home: catchphrase -> an extra PAU_ bark and the last line's tail; team -> the letter's ball game and a cap or patch; item -> a second carried prop beside the cup; tattoo -> a forearm decal under the rolled sleeve.
paul.defaults: Big beard, rolled sleeves, dog tags, a crushed tin cup he carries everywhere

art.hair: short, under a torn wool cap; a big full beard
art.build: powerful and heroic (a strongman, never a joke about size); three growth stages from the stout, about 2.5 m / 2.9 m / 3.25 m
art.clothing: US Army wool shirt and trousers, sleeves rolled past the elbow, what is left of the engineer's sleeve insignia; boots
signature_items: a crushed tin canteen cup in his left hand
the cracked rack of six Helvetia Ironhide bottles on his back with IV lines
art.skin: iron-red like the stout, riveted bone plates pushing through like the Ironhide barrel mascot; never green, no purple trousers (not Marvel's Hulk)

paul.letter_details_default: He asks about a ball game back home and promises to buy the first round.

devin._quirk_doc: DEVIN_SIGNATURE: hair, height, glasses, style... Rendered on the face and silhouette only if given; otherwise the defaults below.
devin.defaults: Very tall, thin, calm; a watchman's greatcoat; a lantern and ring of keys; works the night shift

art.build: about 2.6 m, long-limbed, thin but never skeletal: a person, just too long
art.face: pale, calm, tired; faint violet eyes that never blink. Always a real face: never blank, never featureless
art.clothing: a long dark-grey watchman's greatcoat with brass buttons, collar up, a scarf, a peaked watchman's cap. Never a black suit and tie
signature_items: an old brass lantern burning violet
a heavy ring of keys at the hip
